I have a love-hate relationship with this game :D
I love every aspect of rafting (besides having thalassophobia), collecting stuff, organizing stuff, making the raft bigger and so on. And these aspects are really good in the game.
The game is also awesome in peaceful mode, especially if you have little energy. You can still reach everything in the game, the shark and most other mobs just won't attack.
But the story islands are a pain in the butt if you don't watch tutorials how to do it. At least they were for me.

I would still recommend the game and you will not regret buying it.
It's also fun playing with friends!

Love this game; I've been playing it for years and it's one of my absolute favorites! I feel like it's a game for everyone, whether the player is story-hungry or a survival fanatic or a chill builder (as chill as you can be with a shark constantly chewing away at your raft...); there is truly a place for many, if not every, type of gamer. 

A note worth adding: I'd recommend starting with a friend, whether the friend has played before or not. It can be a little overwhelming at first for new players starting out on their own, but not to say that it's not enjoyable solo! Playing Raft by yourself definitely is an extra challenge ;)
